g.title: J_OBC_MAG
g.text: OBC J10: 3V3_MAG from U35 (MAG_EN PF14), I2C4 segment via U34, DRDY via U33 to PD11 (ICX D, SMA-B18)

g.title: W6E
g.text: (+X, +Y) bundle, 0.055 m routed; pairs (1, 2), (3, 6), (4, 5); the service loop stowed below z +20, away from A2; I2C at 100 kHz; under 2 mA

g.title: J_MAG
g.text: magnetometer board A2 J1 (RM3100 at 0x20), +Z end frame; entered from +X over the RF board

g.title: J_EPS_ADCS
g.text: EPS J20 (bottom side, zone Z1): SW4 3V3_ADCS (ADCS_EN PB6), 0.265-0.339 A trip

g.title: W6B
g.text: twisted pair; 0.049 A worst normal, 0.339 A at the SW4 trip (38 % of 0.90 A derated)

g.title: J_OBC_ADCS
g.text: OBC J6: into U5 (gyro), U6 (BMI088), U7 (sun sensors), U35 (magnetometer)

g.title: J_OBC_MTQ
g.text: OBC J7: DRV8876 U22 (X), U23 (Y), U24 (Z) OUT1/OUT2

g.title: W6C_X
g.text: twisted pair; 0.087 A at 0.2 A.m2, 0.126 A at the bridge limit

g.title: W6C_Y
g.text: twisted pair; -X wall gap, under the EPS across U_X (y +25 ... +29.5), down the (+X, +Y) bundle to the rod's +Y end

g.title: ROD_X
g.text: CubeSpace CR0002 rod X lead (-X end)

g.title: ROD_Y
g.text: CubeSpace CR0002 rod Y lead (+Y end)
AS81824/1 splice in the (+X, +Y) bundle at z -30

g.title: ROD_Z
g.text: CubeSpace CR0002 rod Z lead (top end, z +3)
AS81824/1 splice in the -X wall gap at (y +10, z +12)

g.title: J_OBC_SS
g.text: OBC J8: cathodes to the TLV9002 transimpedance inputs, anodes to ground; 13, 14 not used

g.title: W6D_PX
g.text: six unshielded twisted pairs from one trunk down the (-X, +Y) bundle, branching under the EPS; at most 5.25 mA

g.title: CSS_PX
g.text: +X panel photodiode (in the W2PX pigtail slot at y -30)
